create_llm_passthrough_route: create a pass-through route for any LLM provider using the llm_passthrough_factory_proxy_route function
build_openai_pass_through_handler: build an OpenAI API pass-through handler using BaseOpenAIPassThroughHandler._base_openai_pass_through_handler
run_bedrock_passthrough_route: run an AWS Bedrock LLM API pass-through route via the bedrock_proxy_route endpoint
run_vertex_ai_passthrough_route: run a Vertex AI API pass-through route via the vertex_proxy_route endpoint
create_websocket_passthrough_endpoint: create a generic WebSocket passthrough endpoint for any provider using create_generic_websocket_passthrough_endpoint
